concerns.text: T007b (Static Proxy) depends on T014a (Splitter) but is marked [P] (parallel-safe). T014a produces the specific `validation_set.csv` file required as input for T007b. A task cannot run in parallel with its producer; T007b must be sequential to T014a. The [P] tag is incorrect here.
T008b (Ablation on Validation) depends on T014a (Splitter) but is marked [P]. T014a generates the `validation_set.csv` input. T008b cannot execute until T014a completes. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T008 (Ablation on Train) depends on T014a (Splitter) but is marked [P]. T014a generates the `ablation_train_set.csv` input. T008 cannot execute until T014a completes. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T008c (Sample Check) depends on T008 and T008b, which in turn depend on T014a. T008c is marked [P] in the list but logically must wait for the ablation studies to complete. While the text says 'Depends on: T008, T008b', the [P] tag implies it can run in parallel with them, which is a contradiction.

T014 (Proxy Validation) depends on T007b, T008b, and T014a. It is marked [P] in the list. Since it consumes artifacts from T007b and T008b, it cannot run in parallel with them. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T017 (Dynamic Simulation) depends on T015, T016, T018, and T014a. It is marked [P]. T015 and T016 are implementation tasks that must complete before T017 can run. T017 cannot run in parallel with its dependencies. The [P] tag is incorrect.

T019 (Static Baseline) and T020 (Random Baseline) depend on T018 (Engine Runner). They are marked [P]. While T019 and T020 can run in parallel *with each other*, they cannot run in parallel with T018 (the producer of the engine runner logic). The [P] tag on T019/T020 is ambiguous and potentially misleading if interpreted as 'parallel with T018'.
T024a (Divergence Detection) depends on T017 and T019. It is marked [P]. It cannot run until T017 and T019 complete. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T025 (Statistical Testing) depends on T024a and T021. It is marked [P]. It cannot run until T024a and T021 complete. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T028 (Final Report) depends on T025 and T022a. It is marked [P]. It cannot run until T025 and T022a complete. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T005 (Entropy Calc) depends on T006 (Parser). T005 is marked [P]. It cannot run in parallel with T006. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T009 (Classifier Training) depends on T008, T008c, and T014. It is marked [P]. It cannot run in parallel with these dependencies. The [P] tag is incorrect.
